generateNewText.title: Create new lesson
generateNewText.subtitle: Step 1: generate text → Step 2: generate tasks → edit → save draft.

defaults.title: New lesson
defaults.prompt: Example: Write a story about Edvard Munch and the painting The Scream. Include some facts about the painting and his life.

fields.languageSearchPlaceholder: Search language (e.g. Norwegian, Somali, ti, pt-BR...)
fields.prompt: Here you write instructions for the AI
fields.promptTip: Tip: Write the subject, level, language, topic and desired content. Avoid names and other personal information about students.

a1Start.title: Reading instruction – A1 Start
a1Start.description: Start and finish with the same first-person sentence. Repeat each subject three times with the same verb.
a1Start.highFrequencyDescription: Create one coherent A1 text using a selected high-frequency function word, followed by a simple explanation.
a1Start.soundLadderDescription: Create an A1 text with one focus sound, sound words, and short sound sentences.
a1Start.reviewReminder: Check the text carefully. Replace individual words or sentences if needed.

fields.soundSentenceCount: Number of sentences with the sound
fields.soundWordCount: Number of sound words and sentences

a1Start.highFrequencyHelp: The AI creates one coherent A1 text. Good language comes first. The text ends with Explanation and Example sentences.
a1Start.soundLadderHelp: AI creates sound words first, one sentence per word, and then a short text using several of the words.

placeholders.topic: For example food, school, or family

errors.verbRequired: Enter a verb for A1 Start.

tasks.factsSingleBoxHelp: Fact sentences are written in one box.
tasks.factsPrompt: Write {count} factual sentences from the text. Use your own words and stick to facts.

hints.generateTasks: Generate tasks based on the current text.
hints.approveTextFirst: Approve the text before creating tasks.
hints.tasksDirty: The text has changed since the tasks were generated.

warnings.checkTextBeforeTasks: Please check the text before you generate tasks.
warnings.factCheckRequiredBeforePublish: This text should be extra fact-checked before publishing.
warnings.factCheckCompleted: Extra fact check has been run for this text.
warnings.factCheckReportHelp: The report shows whether the text was left unchanged, or which small factual and language corrections were made.

status.quotaUsed: You have used {used} of {limit} this month
status.quotaExceeded: You have used {used} of {limit} this month. You cannot create more right now.
status.featureUnavailable: This feature is not available for you.

builder.text: Your own or generated text is dispayed here
builder.textHelp: Go to step 2 and create tasks once you have checked the text.

review.title: Review and approve the text
review.body: The teacher must read the text and assess content, level, language and privacy before tasks are generated.
review.approvedBody: You can now generate tasks. If the text changes, it must be approved again.

editor.title: Tasks editor
editor.empty: No tasks yet. Generate tasks or add them manually.
editor.openHint: Open task: the student writes a response.

errors.approveTextFirst: Approve the text before generating tasks.
errors.notSignedIn: Not signed in. Please log in as teacher/producer.
errors.notJsonFromServer: The server did not return JSON.

steps.lockedUntilTextReady: Locked until the text is ready
steps.lockedUntilTasksReady: Locked until the tasks are ready

stepStatus.step1Body: Start by generating a text or pasting your own. When the text is ready, the next step is unlocked.
stepStatus.reviewTextBody: The teacher must approve the text before tasks can be generated.
stepStatus.textReadyBody: The next step is to generate tasks for the text. You can adjust the number of tasks before you continue.
stepStatus.tasksReadyBody: The next step is finishing. There you can add an image, metadata, share to Space, and make final adjustments.

sections.generateOrPasteTextBody: Choose level, language, text type, and prompt. You can also write or paste the text yourself.
sections.generateTasksBody: Choose how many tasks you want. This section is unlocked when the text is ready.
sections.enableTaskGeneratorFirst: Generate or paste text first to activate the task generator.
sections.approveTextFirst: Review the text and click “Approve text and create tasks” before generating tasks.
sections.goToFinishingBody: From here you continue to image, metadata, sharing to Space, and final adjustments.
sections.readyToFinishBody: When the tasks are generated, you can continue to finishing.
